== English errata comparison sources ==
The January 2013 slip restricts deployment to an opposing character. The June 2017 slip then specifies capture, seizure by a bounty hunter and transfer. The retrieval amount, destination for the Effect and Alter immunity are unchanged. The same-bounty-hunter ruling is separate from the game-text changes.

Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=7 Decipher Errata], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 7. Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=106 2023 Advanced Rulebook], Appendix A, PDF page 106. [[:File:CC-D-bounty.gif|Complete replacement face]]. Related ruling: Decipher, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=29 Glossary Version 2.0], November 1998, PDF page 29. The ruling continues on PDF page 30. Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=138 2023 Advanced Rulebook], Appendix B, PDF page 138. The earlier PC wording is documented by Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 7. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]. The earlier article has a publication identifier and empty face and executable fields.
